The problem I solve

1

No backlinks, no trust

What I do

Guest posting and press release, done properly

Two different tools for two different jobs — most campaigns need both.

Part one

What guest posting actually does

A guest post is an article your brand publishes on an already-trusted, relevant website — with a link back to your site placed naturally inside the content.

  • Passes authority ("link equity") from an established site to yours
  • Targets exact keywords you want to rank for — niche relevant, not random
  • Builds topical relevance in Google's eyes — you're seen as an expert in your space
  • Drives real referral traffic from readers of that site, not just SEO value
  • Compounds over time — each placement adds to a growing trust profile
Why it works
Google's algorithm was literally built on counting who links to whom.

A relevant backlink is still one of the strongest ranking signals Google uses — it hasn't gone away, it's just gotten harder to fake.

Result: higher rankings, more organic traffic, lower cost-per-lead over time.
Part two

What press release actually does

Think of it like this: if you keep saying "my company is great," nobody believes you. When a trusted newspaper says it, people believe it instantly. A press release gets that same third-party validation from real news sites — and Google reads it the same way.

Brand mentions

Credible mentions of your brand across news domains — a core trust signal Google's E-E-A-T system looks for.

Backlinks from news domains

News and media sites are high-trust, high-authority domains — links from them carry real weight.

AI search visibility

ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews recommend brands that multiple credible sources talk about.

Brand search results

Searches for your company name return a stronger set of results around your own site.
